title: Wright Field consultant lives with Brown family

tellings.quote:
he actually had a
technical consultant named Charles Wyatt
Miller from right Airfield living with
his family at all times

plain: In the 1950s, a technical consultant named Charles Wyatt Miller, from Wright Field, an American military air base and research center, is said to have lived with a family named Brown all the time. Michels passes this on from Linda Brown, a member of that family, while asking whether the atomic scientist Robert Oppenheimer worked on UFOs. Having a military expert in the house at all times would suggest the family's work was being closely watched by the Air Force.
